annotation.title_clean: Resolution on the need to undertake a Study on human and peoples' rights and artificial intelligence (AI), robotics and other new and emerging technologies in Africa - ACHPR/Res. 473 (EXT.OS/ XXXI) 2021
annotation.title_en: Resolution on the need to undertake a Study on human and peoples' rights and artificial intelligence (AI), robotics and other new and emerging technologies in Africa - ACHPR/Res. 473 (EXT.OS/ XXXI) 2021
annotation.authors_or_issuer: African Commission on Human and Peoples' Rights (ACHPR)
annotation.summary_en: Resolution of the African Commission on Human and Peoples' Rights (March 2021) recognising the human-rights opportunities and risks of AI, robotics and emerging technologies in Africa, citing meaningful human control over autonomous weapons, and calling for a comprehensive study and governance framework.
key_provisions_or_claims: Commissions a study on human rights and AI, robotics and emerging technologies in Africa
Notes lack of a comprehensive framework governing AI companies' human-rights compliance
Reaffirms meaningful human control over machine autonomy in use of force (General Comment 3)
Calls for a continental AI governance framework protecting rights and data ownership
Stresses African participation in international AI governance
